title: Nscale and Anthropic are reportedly in talks for yet another $45B compute deal
script:
Forty five billion dollars. That is the size of the compute deal Anthropic and Nscale are discussing.
If the agreement goes through, it would rank among the largest infrastructure partnerships in the sector.
This follows a long string of giant compute deals Anthropic has struck over the past year.
TechCrunch broke the news about the ongoing discussions between both companies.
Will these massive financial commitments ensure reliable compute capacity for future AI development?
